comparison.objective: Set a lathe tool to center height using a pinched steel rule, rather than tune a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual rule pinching, visual angular judgment, and tool-height adjustment versus recessed key use, collar rotation, counterholding, and dynamic feedback.
comparison.success_condition: Tool reaches center height as indicated by the rule; body only names the directory, with no spec versions or tolerance/damage rubric. Candidate requires quantified cycles, stroke limits, and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Both are adjustment tasks, but they measure different abilities: static geometric setup versus iterative impact-energy control and relocking.
